subproblem.title: A.e. strong measurability of an approximate-tangent-plane projection field
subproblem.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let M ⊆ ℝ^P be any set (measurability is not assumed) with Hⁿ(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, where Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Let Q be any map from ℝ^P to the linear subspaces of ℝ^P such that, for Hⁿ⌞M-almost every x, Q(x) is an approximate tangent space of M at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x): dim Q(x) = n and ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dHⁿ → ∫_{Q(x)} f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x) is blowUpMap x r). Then the field of orthogonal projections x ↦ p_{Q(x)} = (Q x).starProjection ∈ L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable (AEStronglyMeasurable for μHE[n].restrict M).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x)) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (Q x).starProjection) (μHE[n].restrict M)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: steps 1–2 of the parent proof of cbr_ci_isIntegerMultiplicity_of_ae_tangent (measurability of the tangent-plane field), stated for an arbitrary a.e. approximate-tangent field Q instead of approxTangentPlane n M; the parent applies it with Q := approxTangentPlane n M. Steps 2(a), 2(b) and 2(d) of that proof are the sibling theorems (QM) = exists_plane_cutoff_quadratic_moment_eq, (BC) = continuous_blowUp_image_setIntegral and (PF) = aemeasurable_starProjection_of_aemeasurable_norm_sq, used exactly as stated; step 2(c) is carried out below.

Notation. Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^P; μ := Hⁿ⌞M = μHE[n].restrict M; p_x := (Q x).starProjection; η_{x,r} := blowUpMap x r, η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x); ∫_A g dHⁿ := ∫ g d(Hⁿ⌞A). Let G be the set of x with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x); by hypothesis G holds μ-a.e.

1. Case n = 0. For x ∈ G the dimension clause of the definition gives finrank Q(x) = 0, hence Q(x) = ⊥ (Submodule.finrank_eq_zero), and p_x is the orthogonal projection onto the zero subspace, i.e. p_x v = 0 for every v, so p_x = 0. Thus x ↦ p_x agrees μ-a.e. with the constant map 0, which is strongly measurable, and a function μ-a.e. equal to an a.e. strongly measurable function is a.e. strongly measurable (AEStronglyMeasurable.congr). This proves the claim for n = 0. From now on n ≥ 1.

2. The plane moments. By (QM) (applicable since n ≥ 1) there is c > 0 such that for every linear subspace Q' ⊆ ℝ^P with finrank Q' = n and every u ∈ ℝ^P: ∫_{Q'} max(1 − |y|², 0)⟨u, y⟩² dHⁿ(y) = c|p_{Q'} u|².

3. The test function. Fix u ∈ ℝ^P and put f_u(y) := max(1 − |y|², 0)⟨u, y⟩². It is continuous (built from the norm, the inner product, max and products). If |y| > 1 then 1 − |y|² < 0, so max(1 − |y|², 0) = 0 and f_u(y) = 0; hence f_u vanishes outside the compact closed unit ball and has compact support (HasCompactSupport.intro). So f_u defines an element F_u ∈ C_c(ℝ^P, ℝ) with F_u(y) = f_u(y) for all y.

4. A sequence of radii. Put r_k := 1/(k + 1), k ∈ ℕ. Then r_k > 0 and r_k → 0 (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat); since every r_k lies in (0, ∞), r_k → 0 along the filter 𝓝[>] 0 (tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff).

5. Measurable approximants. For k ∈ ℕ let Φ_k(x) := ∫_{η_{x,r_k}(M)} f_u dHⁿ. By (BC), applied to M (its hypothesis Hⁿ(M ∩ K) < ∞ for compact K is exactly ours), to the continuous compactly supported f_u and to r_k > 0, each Φ_k is continuous on ℝ^P, hence Borel measurable, hence μ-a.e. measurable.

6. Pointwise limits. Let x ∈ G. Applying the definition of HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x) to the test function F_u gives ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f_u dHⁿ → ∫_{Q(x)} f_u dHⁿ as r → 0 along 𝓝[>] 0; composing with step 4, Φ_k(x) → ∫_{Q(x)} f_u dHⁿ as k → ∞. The dimension clause gives finrank Q(x) = n, so by step 2 this limit is c|p_x u|². Hence Φ_k(x) → c|p_x u|² for μ-a.e. x.

7. Quadratic forms are a.e. measurable. A μ-a.e. limit of a sequence of μ-a.e. measurable real functions is μ-a.e. measurable (aemeasurable_of_tendsto_metrizable_ae'). By steps 5–6, x ↦ c|p_x u|² is μ-a.e. measurable; multiplying by the constant c⁻¹ (c > 0) shows that x ↦ |p_x u|² = c⁻¹·(c|p_x u|²) is μ-a.e. measurable. This holds for every u ∈ ℝ^P.

8. The projection field. By (PF), applied to the measure μ and the field K := Q, step 7 implies that x ↦ p_x is μ-a.e. measurable as a map into L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) with its Borel σ-algebra.

9. Strong measurability. L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) is a finite-dimensional normed space, hence metrizable and second countable, and its σ-algebra is the Borel one; for such targets a.e. measurability implies a.e. strong measurability (AEMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable). Hence x ↦ (Q x).starProjection is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable. ∎

Lean reference implementation (kernel-checked during this decomposition with lake env lean in the contract scope — `import GMT.Ch07.Submission`, `namespace GMT.Ch07` and the contract's opens — after the accepted candidate declarations of the three sibling theorems; #print axioms gives propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; the statement line is the frozen type verbatim):
theorem Submission.cbr_ci_imc_tangent_field_aestronglyMeasurable : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x)) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (Q x).starProjection) (μHE[n].restrict M) := by
  intro P n M Q hloc htan
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · refine (aestronglyMeasurable_const (b := (0 : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P))).congr ?_
    filter_upwards [htan] with x hx
    have h0 : Q x = ⊥ := Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.1 hx.1
    rw [h0]
    ext v
    simp
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hmom⟩ := Submission.exists_plane_cutoff_quadratic_moment_eq n hn
    apply AEMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    apply Submission.aemeasurable_starProjection_of_aemeasurable_norm_sq
    intro u
    set f : Euclid P → ℝ := fun y => max (1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2) 0 * inner ℝ u y ^ 2 with hf_def
    have hfc : Continuous f := by
      simp only [hf_def]
      fun_prop
    have hfs : HasCompactSupport f := by
      apply HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : Euclid P) 1)
      intro y hy
      simp only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hy
      have h1 : 1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg y]
      simp [hf_def, max_eq_right h1]
    let F : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Euclid P) ℝ := ⟨⟨f, hfc⟩, hfs⟩
    let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
    have hrpos : ∀ k, 0 < r k := fun k => by positivity
    have hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝[>] 0) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.2 ⟨tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat,
        Eventually.of_forall hrpos⟩
    have hmeas : ∀ k, AEMeasurable (fun x => ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x (r k) '' M, f y ∂μHE[n]) (μHE[n].restrict M) := fun k =>
      (Submission.continuous_blowUp_image_setIntegral P n M hloc f hfc hfs (r k) (hrpos k)).measurable.aemeasurable
    have hlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x (r k) '' M, f y ∂μHE[n]) atTop (𝓝 (c * ‖(Q x).starProjection u‖ ^ 2)) := by
      filter_upwards [htan] with x hx
      rw [← hmom P (Q x) hx.1 u]
      exact (hx.2 F).comp hr
    have h1 : AEMeasurable (fun x => c * ‖(Q x).starProjection u‖ ^ 2) (μHE[n].restrict M) :=
      aemeasurable_of_tendsto_metrizable_ae' hmeas hlim
    refine (h1.const_mul c⁻¹).congr (Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    simp only
    rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne', one_mul]
proof_key_steps: n = 0: at a.e. x the plane Q(x) has dimension 0, so Q(x) = ⊥ and p_{Q(x)} = 0 a.e.
n ≥ 1: (QM) gives c > 0 with ∫_{Q'} f_u dHⁿ = c|p_{Q'}u|² for every n-plane Q', where f_u(y) = max(1−|y|²,0)⟨u,y⟩² is continuous with compact support.
(BC): Φ_k(x) = ∫_{η_{x,1/(k+1)}(M)} f_u dHⁿ is continuous in x; at a.e. x the tangent-space definition gives Φ_k(x) → c|p_{Q(x)}u|².
Hence x ↦ |p_{Q(x)}u|² is a.e. measurable for every u (a.e. limit of measurable functions, divided by c > 0).
(PF) gives a.e. measurability of x ↦ p_{Q(x)}, which is a.e. strong measurability in the finite-dimensional space L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P).

audit.reason: The prose exactly matches the locally finite, arbitrary-set contract. The n = 0 case gives an a.e. zero projection. For n > 0, the declared moment and continuity dependencies provide measurable approximants converging a.e. to c times each quadratic form; c > 0 permits division. The declared polarization dependency and finite-dimensional second countability give a.e. strong measurability. The supplied implementation independently compiles with precisely these dependency types as hypotheses.
